none: PAS SOM-09AC33: Roman Oxfordshire red/brown slipped ware vessel
contea di ritrovamento: North Somerset (Inghilterra e Galles)

An assemblage of five sherds of Roman Oxfordshire red/brow slipped ware dating to the period c. AD 240 - 410. The assemblage consists of two rim sherds, two body sherds and one base sherd. One of the rim sherds is flanged, the other is beaded. The sherds are heavily abraded, with little or no slip remaining. The fabric is hard, with a slightly laminar texture.
